blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police authorities have arrested a high-value drug suspect and seized from him P430,000 worth of alleged marijuana during the implementation of a search warrant in Kidapawan City, North Cotabato. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) regional director, said joint personnel of the Kidapawan City Police Office, Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency, and North Cotabato Police Provincial Office served the search warrant at about 4 a.m. on Tuesday against alias “Eco,” 39, a resident of Perez Street, Barangay Poblacion.
